ifnd.text_scope: Indian news headline / statement text (English), not full articles

dataset.text_scope: ifnd: Indian news headline / statement text (English), not full articles; hindi_news: full Hindi news article text
dataset.version: 2024-06 (Hindi Zenodo record) / IFND release as mirrored

detail.note: IFND's date column has no year for most FALSE items, so this split is inherently small

deployment.gate_policy: Gate is fixed before training and is never relaxed to make a model deployable. A model that fails any condition stays discovery-only and contributes zero weight.

hyperparameters.tie_break: document frequency desc, then feature string asc

label_scheme.ai_generated: not modelled: AI-text detection is a separate signal. These corpora contain no AI-generation labels, so this model makes no claim about AI-written news.
label_scheme.mixed_class: not represented: neither corpus supports a trustworthy MIXED/MISLEADING class. IFND's own label column is binary TRUE/Fake, and its MISLEADING *topic* rows are already labelled Fake by the dataset authors.

reproducibility.randomness: none - every partition and ordering uses stable cryptographic hashes
